input: Merge /config/defaults.ini and /config/custom.ini. Custom values should override defaults within the same section. Keys only in defaults should be preserved. Write the merged result to /config/merged.ini and print it. Sections are denoted by [section_name] headers.

tool_calls:
python3 -c "
import configparser

config = configparser.ConfigParser()
config.optionxform = str
config.read('/config/defaults.ini')
config.read('/config/custom.ini')

with open('/config/merged.ini', 'w') as f:
    config.write(f, space_around_delimiters=False)

with open('/config/merged.ini') as f:
    print(f.read())
"
